newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: Madagascar president appoints more ministers.
newsitem.headline: Madagascar president appoints more ministers.

text.p: Madagascar's interim president on Thursday named the final two ministers in a cabinet that will last until November elections.
Norbert Ratsirahonana, interim president and prime minister, named Etienne Rakotomaria the higher education minister and Jacques Ratsimbazafy minister of the environment.
Ratsirahonana said he delayed the appointments when he announced his cabinet last week because the two were abroad.
The new government is composed Ratsirahonana, three vice-premiers, 27 ministers and two secretaries of state. Its main job is to prepare for presidential elections on November 3.
On Wednesday, the government asked the constitutional court to review its decision on holding elections on that date. It argued that it did not have adequate time for the task.

Former president Albert Zafy, whose impeachment by parliament for violations of the constitution was confirmed by a constitutional court on September 4, will stand in the election and has said delays in the poll could cause unrest.
